name: Client Brief — Should NOT Trigger
assertion: For every query below, estate-client-brief must NOT load, or must load only to decline and hand off. The named owner loads instead where one is given.

should_not_trigger.query: What does the Brady trust say?
Show me the disposition diagram for the joint revocable trust
What are the beneficiary designations on the accounts?
should_not_trigger.note: Account-level beneficiary designations live on the balance sheet, not the client record — distinct from the family-members-by-name gap this skill declines.

should_not_trigger.query: Here's a PDF, add it to the Brady file

should_not_trigger.note: Tax is a separate skill set. Estate skills must actively refuse.

should_not_trigger.query: What happens if Robert died today?

should_not_trigger.note: All-documents sweep — no skill in this set does this; wealth-estate-plan-overview was retired precisely because it can't be done honestly.

should_not_trigger.query: Build me a report on this household

success_criteria: Zero of the twelve queries are answered as if this skill owns them
Queries with a named owner route to that skill
Queries marked decline produce a refusal that does not name the missing capability
The two near-boundary cases (beneficiary designations, tax rate) are decided correctly and consistently across repeated runs
notes: This set reflects the skill's current scope — household-wide roles and named family members are declined here, not answered — so this file is built against that scope.
